In the meantime, it is provided that in

WPMS No. 2400 of 2019 
Hon’ble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Heard Mr. Pankaj Kumar, Advocate, 
holding brief of Mr. Neeraj Garg, Advocate for 
the petitioner. 
Issue fresh notice to respondent no. 2, 
returnable at an early date, by registered 
post, acknowledgment due. 
In addition to normal mode of service, 
petitioner is permitted to serve respondent 
no. 2 personally through her counsel 
appearing before the Court below. 
Steps to be taken by 19.09.2019. 
List this matter after three weeks. 
In the meantime, it is provided that in 
case any application for adjournment of the 
case is moved by the petitioner, learned Court 
below shall consider the same for grant of 
adjournment for a period of three weeks.
